wfMfbodIbMw.title: You Don't Retire From A Gang, You Get Reassigned — Makgothi Thobakgale Exposes Choppies
wfMfbodIbMw.description:
"I have encountered inmates that are not supposed to be in a particular span. The recent example is Kuruman Correctional Facility, I found an inmate there who is a gang member transferred from the Western Cape. Choppies is his name. I found him working in the kitchen." DCS Commissioner Makgothi Thobakgale

"The report then says Choppies is a self-confessed member of the gang and a leader, but he has also indicated that he has retired. Now, you don't retire from the gang, you get reassigned." Makgothi Thobakgale

vTMZY8tPoIo.title: Justice Madlanga Pauses Hearing To Mark 1 Year Anniversary Of The Madlanga Commission
vTMZY8tPoIo.description: The Madlanga Commission marks one year since its first public hearing on September 17, 2025, having probed corruption and criminal infiltration within South Africa's criminal justice system. Chaired by retired Constitutional Court Justice Mbuyiseli Madlanga, the inquiry was established following explosive revelations by KwaZulu-Natal Police Commissioner Lieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi
